text: {"verifiable":true,"metric":"cash_conversion_cycle","formula":"365 * ((inventory_FY2018 + inventory_FY2019) / 2) / cost_of_sales_FY2019 + 365 * ((receivables_FY2018 + receivables_FY2019) / 2) / net_sales_FY2019 - 365 * ((accounts_payable_FY2018 + accounts_payable_FY2019) / 2) / (cost_of_sales_FY2019 + (inventory_FY2019 - inventory_FY2018))","roles":[{"name":"inventory_FY2018","aliases":["Inventories"],"period":"FY2018"},{"name":"inventory_FY2019","aliases":["Inventories"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"receivables_FY2018","aliases":["Receivables"],"period":"FY2018"},{"name":"receivables_FY2019","aliases":["Receivables"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"accounts_payable_FY2018","aliases":["Accounts payable"],"period":"FY2018"},{"name":"accounts_payable_FY2019","aliases":["Accounts payable"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"cost_of_sales_FY2019","aliases":["Cost of sales"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"net_sales_FY2019","aliases":["Net sales"],"period":"FY2019"}],"claim_unit":"days","formula_source":"document_derived"}
